pages.text: Lanterns, a table and chairs support the occupied street around actual housing.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A bed belongs to a specific resident; leaves are not a roof. Profession, job site and actual route must agree. One workplace does not serve every resident.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: An accessible personal roofed bed and compatible workplace provide actual needs, not a building beauty score.
